text.p: Lebanon's biggest company Solidere began marketing on Tuesday Global Depository Receipts (GDRs) worth $115-$125 million for issue on November 26, market sources said.
"They launched an offer of GDRs today. They are making an international offering of 10 million GDRs for an issue size of $125 million," a source told Reuters.
A Solidere executive questioned by Reuters on the report declined to comment.
The sources said each GDR would be worth one tenth of one of Solidere's shares. The company's A and B shares traded on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday at $114 and $117.75.
The price range on the GDRs was $11.5 to $12.5 for an issue price of $115-$125 million, the source said.

The issue is lead managed by Merrill Lynch International, with a selling syndicate formed by ING Barings, Robert Fleming and Co, Paribas Capital Markets and UBS Ltd and roadshows will take place in the United States, Europe and elsewhere, a source said.
